doc.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
doc.interviewee: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey

title: California in 1916 and joining Billy Mack's show
summary: Dates for the California stay, Billy Mack sending for him, meeting in St. Louis in 1919 and playing with drummer Bobby in Sacramento.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: When were you in California? Do you remember really about when?
In 1916. I played, went back in 1926.
Now he had me in three months.
Now he had me in seven months.

Needless, I can remember he went out there. And he's out there a year better. And I think Billy Mack sent for you to join me in the game. And I sent for you to join him in Kansas City, didn't you? Yes. Billy Mack, you joined the show. In St. Louis. Well, St. Louis, that's when I met you in St. Louis. That was 1919. I tried. And we passed for brothers. That's how he wanted it.
I quit the band in 1917. Well, when the show got here I think you quit. In 1917, that was?

The show got here and then you played at Tom Anderson's. Until you got your teeth fixed. Yeah, how did you play with your players? And when the circus come through here you and her grabbed the show and went back out on the coast because they used to win it in California. And that's how he went back out to California. And he went up, took a little bit of a round. What is Sacramento? That address you should have, some rare address. Was that Sacramento?
Yes, we had five pieces. Rush panel and spare horn.
What's the drummer's name from here? He was playing with you wasn't he? Yes. Bobby. Yeah, I played with Bobby in California.
Bobby. He was in that band. He was in that band.
